description: Send sounds from web and Android apps to Ableton Live: the npm package la2l (a client, WAV files from Web Audio, a Send to Live web component, a test receiver), the REST API and the app2live/1 package description.
rules: Give every sound kind: 'loop' or kind: 'oneshot'. A loop without kind: 'loop' arrives in Live as a one-shot, out of time.
Send WAV only. Make it with wavFromAudioBuffer, wavFromSamples or toWav from 'la2l'.
Render a loop a whole number of beats long, and give its bpm.
Pair once, with the code the user reads in Live. Ask for a code again only after the error code not_paired.
Never put the app token in a URL, a log line or an error report.
Test without Ableton: npx la2l test-receiver --local, or startTestReceiver() from 'la2l/testing'.
